nodes.label: eBay Marketplace Service (backend/services/marketplace/ebay.js)

nodes.label: eBay MCP Production Read-Only Constraint
nodes.rationale: Official eBay MCP supports production only (no sandbox), rejects POST/PUT/DELETE, defaults to application token mode, and requires EBAY_TOKEN_TYPE=user plus EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN for seller data; therefore mutations and shop sync must remain in backend/services/marketplace/ebay.js.

nodes.label: eBay US-Only Marketplace Scope
nodes.rationale: Dashboard connects only the organization's own US eBay shop (EBAY_US, USD, category tree 0); multi-site eBay shops are excluded.

nodes.label: Marketplace Dispatch via shop.marketplace
nodes.rationale: Sync, stock, and price flows must dispatch dynamically using shop.marketplace rather than assuming a single marketplace implementation.

nodes.label: Temu MD5 Request Signing (sign_method=md5)
nodes.rationale: Sorts all parameter keys except sign, concatenates key+value without separators, wraps both ends with app_secret, computes uppercase hex MD5 over the exact JSON payload sent, and forbids logging app_secret, access_token, or code.

nodes.label: Temu US Local-Seller Scope & No-MCP Rule
nodes.norm_label: temu us local-seller scope & no-mcp rule
nodes.rationale: Temu does not publish an official MCP server, so third-party Temu MCPs are banned in favor of partner-us.temu.com; scope is restricted to the US local-seller path, excluding EU/global routers and cross-border Seller Center.

nodes.label: Replace Hardcoded getService('ebay') Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Existing dashboard code hardcodes getService('ebay') for stock, price, orders, and listings; adding TikTok Shop requires dispatching on shop.marketplace.

nodes.label: TikTok Shop HMAC-SHA256 Signing & shop_cipher
nodes.rationale: Signs requests with HMAC-SHA256 (app_secret key over app_secret + path + sorted query excluding sign/access_token + exact body + app_secret, lowercase hex), passes x-tts-access-token, and supplies shop_cipher from Get Authorized Shops.

nodes.label: TikTok US Seller-Developed Custom App Scope
nodes.norm_label: tiktok us seller-developed custom app scope
nodes.rationale: Targets only the organization's own US TikTok Shop via partner.us.tiktokshop.com as a seller-developed custom app (not ISV, not UK/EU), and prohibits TikTok for Business MCP because business-api.tiktok.com is the Ads API rather than Shop.

nodes.label: TTS Open Toolkit Safety Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Prevents printing/persisting secrets or cookies, prefers allowlisted devapi call over raw auth request, excludes /api/v2/sandbox/account/delete, blocks PPE headers in normal production runs, and gates package installs with --yes.

nodes.label: Six-Digit YYYYMM API Version Selection Policy
nodes.norm_label: six-digit yyyymm api version selection policy
nodes.rationale: Bundled OAS is only a local baseline that may omit newer docv2 endpoints, and a higher YYYYMM path for a different capability cannot substitute for the requested operation; selects the highest YYYYMM satisfying identical capability and explicit constraints.

nodes.label: Sandbox Material Idempotency & Scope Rules
nodes.rationale: Restricts execution to the five typed sandbox commands, prevents recreating orders during 30s indexing visibility delays, prohibits raw sandbox call / --version / PPE headers, and retains created orders because no cleanup route exists.

nodes.label: Pilot Supersonic Delta Wing / Navigation Emblem
nodes.norm_label: pilot supersonic delta wing / navigation emblem

nodes.label: Official eBay MCP Read-Only Integration
nodes.rationale: Uses official ebay-api MCP (@ebay/npm-public-api-mcp) with query_ebay_api, call_ebay_api, and prompt interpret_user_request for production GET reads only (application mode by default, EBAY_TOKEN_TYPE=user + EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN for seller inventory/orders/account); sandbox and POST/PUT/DELETE are rejected and unofficial eBay MCPs are forbidden.

nodes.label: eBay US-Only Shop Policy
nodes.rationale: Connects only our own United States eBay shop using marketplace EBAY_US, currency USD, and category tree 0; other eBay sites must not be added.

nodes.label: TikTok Shop Dashboard Connector Spec
nodes.rationale: Adds backend/services/marketplace/tiktok.js registered as 'tiktok_shop' (not 'tiktok') matching eBay core methods and dispatching via shop.marketplace instead of hardcoding getService('ebay'); reads TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_KEY, TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_SECRET, TIKTOK_SHOP_SERVICE_ID from marketplaces.js and persists tokens, expiry, and shop_cipher on Shop.auth.

nodes.label: TikTok Shop HMAC-SHA256 Signing
nodes.rationale: Selects highest applicable six-digit API version from tts-openapi-guide and signs requests using HMAC-SHA256 with app_secret over app_secret + path + sorted query (excluding sign and access_token) + exact body + app_secret in lowercase hex, passing x-tts-access-token and shop_cipher from Get Authorized Shops.

nodes.norm_label: indigo primary & 80-90% neutral semantic color system
nodes.rationale: Keeping 80-90% of the UI neutral and reserving Indigo (#4F46E5) for interactive actions and semantic colors (Green/Amber/Red/Blue/Grey) for statuses prevents visual fatigue.

nodes.label: Geist Typography & Type Scale
nodes.rationale: Restricting to a single UI font (Geist) and establishing hierarchy via size and weight (400/500/600/700) preserves numeric legibility without visual clutter.

nodes.label: 4px Spacing Scale, Restrained Radius & Elevation System
nodes.norm_label: 4px spacing scale, restrained radius & elevation system
nodes.rationale: Structured 6-12px radii, background+border cards instead of heavy shadows, and 120-200ms transitions keep the ERP feeling fast and disciplined rather than playful.

nodes.label: ERP Tables, Forms, Buttons, Cards, Modals & Drawers
nodes.norm_label: erp tables, forms, buttons, cards, modals & drawers
nodes.rationale: Matches container complexity to task scope: modals for confirmations/quick edits, drawers for record previews, and full pages for complex multi-step workflows and large datasets.

nodes.label: 24-Hour Evidence Memory Cache (evidenceMemory.js)
nodes.rationale: Reuses previously confirmed candidates from the last 24 hours by marketplace product ID, store URL, or title while preserving original observedAt.

nodes.label: Research API Routes, Encrypted AI Settings & Catalog Export
nodes.norm_label: research api routes, encrypted ai settings & catalog export
nodes.rationale: Stores OpenAI key/model encrypted in app_settings (default gpt-5-mini with low reasoning fallback), guards single-run concurrency via 409, and defends CSV exports against formula injection.

nodes.rationale: Verifies eBay items via official EBAY_US Browse API and other sites via HTTP 200, product ID, non-bot, and Shopify Product/USD markup checks, dropping products with no confirmed US link.

nodes.label: US 7+1 Marketplace Search Scope (No Supplier/Margin Research)
nodes.norm_label: us 7+1 marketplace search scope (no supplier/margin research)
nodes.rationale: Restricts discovery to 7 US marketplaces (eBay, Amazon, Walmart, Temu, TikTok Shop, Etsy, Wish) plus US Shopify fallback capped at Tier 4 evidence, excluding non-US domains, Zendesk, and wholesale/margin research.

nodes.label: Frontend Vite + React + Oxlint Build Configuration
nodes.norm_label: frontend vite + react + oxlint build configuration
nodes.rationale: Keeps React Compiler disabled to avoid dev and build performance overhead while supporting Oxc or SWC React Vite plugins.

nodes.norm_label: shared frontend core layer (ui, api.js, useapi.js, marketplaces.js, authcontext)

nodes.norm_label: project development agreement (unified marketplace dashboard + ai market research bot)

nodes.label: Skills Consolidation (33 to 28 Legacy Market Research Skills)
nodes.norm_label: skills consolidation (33 to 28 legacy market research skills)
nodes.rationale: Merged 9 overlapping micro-skills into 4 unified skills to eliminate prompt fragmentation and redundant token costs; marked internal developer reference only so runtime agents do not load or cite it.

nodes.label: US Product Page Grounding & eBay Median Price Anchor Rules
nodes.norm_label: us product page grounding & ebay median price anchor rules
nodes.rationale: Requires exact US product-page URLs (never search pages or non-US domains), excludes 'similar' matches from price evidence, and anchors suggested sell price to eBay median rather than Amazon.

nodes.label: Deterministic Backend Scoring (40/30/30) & Confidence Cap
nodes.rationale: Backend computes the 0-100 score from Demand (40), Rating (30, -8 for highDefectRisk), and Sold evidence (30) while capping sparse evidence at 55; the LLM only writes factual aiNotes without inventing facts or mentioning margin/suppliers.

nodes.label: US Retail Search Grounding & Product Exclusion Policy
nodes.norm_label: us retail search grounding & product exclusion policy
nodes.rationale: Forbids site: operators (runner restricts domains), search-snippet estimates, wholesale lookups, brand-gated/counterfeit goods, and regulated categories (supplements, cosmetics, lithium batteries, weapons, vapes, unsafe children's items).

nodes.label: Wholesale Fulfillment Compliance, US Supplier Preference & Fee Baselines
nodes.norm_label: wholesale fulfillment compliance, us supplier preference & fee baselines
nodes.rationale: Prefers manufacturer_wholesale over retail_marketplace (eBay bans fulfilling eBay orders directly from retail sites), skips login-walled 1688, prefers US suppliers within 20% of overseas cost because de minimis is suspended, and delegates margin math to backend fee configs.

nodes.label: Modern Enterprise Design Direction (FIND -> UNDERSTAND -> ACT -> CONFIRM)
nodes.norm_label: modern enterprise design direction (find -> understand -> act -> confirm)
nodes.rationale: An ERP is a high-density productivity tool handling serious business data (Linear x Stripe x modern accounting), not a flashy marketing site or Dribbble-style card showcase.

nodes.label: Workflow-First UX, Progressive Disclosure & Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Designing around end-to-end Sales/Inventory/Accounts workflows with progressive disclosure, explicit destructive-action impact summaries, actionable empty/error states, and keyboard/non-color accessibility keeps frequent tasks fast and safe.

nodes.label: Tier-First Deterministic Economics Scoring (economics.js)
nodes.rationale: Computes deterministic 0-100 scores (sales 45, velocity 20, reviews 15, freshness 10, corroboration 10 minus penalties) in backend code without LLM math and ranks by evidence tier first, then score, then confirmed shop count.

nodes.label: Incremental $push Persistence & Crash/Stop Recovery
nodes.rationale: Processes 5 products concurrently and appends each passing item immediately via $push so UI polling shows early results and user stops or server crashes preserve confirmed findings.

nodes.label: Pre-Hydration Theme & Indigo/Dark Meta Initialization
nodes.rationale: Reads localStorage('ecompilot-theme') synchronously before React mounts to toggle the dark class and theme-color meta (#4F46E5 light / #0c1222 dark) without a flash of wrong theme.

nodes.label: Section Isolation & 5-Step Route-Gating Convention
nodes.rationale: Bans cross-section imports and duplicated UI primitives while pairing frontend RouteAccess + Sidebar gating with backend MAIN_ROUTES and requireMainRoute authorization.

nodes.label: Temu Dashboard Connector & Order State Mapping
nodes.norm_label: temu dashboard connector & order state mapping
nodes.rationale: Implements TemuService in backend/services/marketplace/temu.js registered under 'temu' with TEMU_APP_KEY, TEMU_APP_SECRET, and region fixed to 'us', matching eBay core interface (getAuthUrl, exchangeCode, refreshToken, getOrders, getInventory, createListing, updateStock, updatePrice), storing token/mall_id on Shop.auth, and mapping Temu states into pending|paid|processing|shipped|delivered|cancelled|returned|refunded.

nodes.label: Temu Local-Seller OAuth & Token Exchange
nodes.rationale: Authorizes at seller.temu.com/open-platform/client-manage/authorization and exchanges code via bg.open.accesstoken.create (with code as initial access_token) to receive mall_id and access_token; uses documented US local methods such as bg.local.goods.detail.query rather than invented names.

nodes.label: Temu Router & MD5 Request Signing
nodes.rationale: Every call is POST application/json with API name in 'type', app_key, 10-digit unix timestamp within 300 seconds, access_token, data_type=JSON, and sign_method=md5 uppercase hex over app_secret + sorted key+value concatenation + app_secret without logging secrets.

nodes.label: Temu US Local-Seller Path Policy
nodes.rationale: Connects only our own US Temu shop via the US local-seller router (https://openapi-b-us.temu.com/openapi/router) and US Partner Platform docs; rejects EU/global routers, cross-border Seller Center, and third-party Temu MCP servers because Temu publishes no official MCP server.

nodes.label: ISV App Onboarding Path
nodes.rationale: Path for independent software vendors building multi-seller apps; requires Partner Center developer account, company/entity qualification, sandbox testing, OAuth/webhook setup, and mandatory app review prior to launch.

nodes.label: Seller Developer Custom App Path
nodes.rationale: Path for merchants building internal ERP/WMS tools bound to their own active TikTok Shop seller account; avoids marketplace-style multi-seller app review while still enforcing API and security rules.

nodes.label: 3PL and 4PL Logistics Models
nodes.rationale: Defines 3PL (third-party logistics shipped by seller) versus 4PL (platform-managed logistics shipped by platform).

nodes.label: Developer Shop, CB, Local Shop, and Bundle Terms
nodes.norm_label: developer shop, cb, local shop, and bundle terms
nodes.rationale: Standardizes external developer terminology: Developer shop (sandbox/test shop), CB (cross-border shop), Local shop (local seller shop), and bundle (combined_skus product set).

nodes.label: CLI Configuration & Cache Precedence
nodes.rationale: Resolves effective configuration via --config > TTS_OPEN_TOOLKIT_CONFIG > project .tts_open_toolkit/config.json > OS user config > defaults; stores update cache in OS cache or TTS_OPEN_TOOLKIT_STATE_PATH with an immutable UUID v4 anonymousInstallationId.

nodes.label: Fixed OAuth DevAPI Allowlist (13 Methods)
nodes.rationale: Restricts devapi call to 13 allowlisted Partner Center routes (account-basic-info, account-certification-info, developer-app-list/detail/exists, document-api-meta, authorization-open-api-list, sandbox-shop-list, sandbox-account-list, partner-service-list/detail, partner-profile, open-app-list) and recursively strips secret fields.

nodes.label: Managed Host Hooks & Local History
nodes.rationale: Installs idempotent Codex and Claude Code hooks with backups and --dry-run, keeping prompt and skill-usage history local under .tts_open_toolkit/history/.

nodes.label: TTSPC OAuth Profile & Protected Credential Store
nodes.norm_label: ttspc oauth profile & protected credential store
nodes.rationale: Uses public client_id=open_toolkit_cli with scope open_toolkit:developer and shell:false browser launching (open, xdg-open, Base64 UTF-16LE PowerShell Start-Process), isolating non-secret profile metadata in ~/.tts_open_toolkit/config.json from tokens in macOS Keychain or Windows CurrentUser DPAPI.

nodes.label: Typed BSO v3 Sandbox Order Workflow
nodes.norm_label: typed bso v3 sandbox order workflow
nodes.rationale: Pins sandbox shop/product/order commands to BSO API v3 (rejects --version), translates numeric backend status codes (e.g., 105 -> ON_HOLD, 111 -> AWAITING_SHIPMENT) to canonical state names, and fails closed on unknown codes or unchanged transitions.

nodes.label: CLI Update Channels (beta/rc/stable)
nodes.rationale: User update channel defaults to beta (cannot be overridden by project config) and requires explicit --yes before executing global npm installation.

nodes.label: @tts-open-toolkit/cli (tts_open_toolkit)
nodes.rationale: Official CLI entry point managing coding-agent skills, TTSPC OAuth profiles, 13 fixed DevAPI methods, typed BSO v3 sandbox order workflows, Codex/Claude/Trae host hooks, local history, shell completion, and package updates.

nodes.label: Auth, Token, Timestamp & Signature FAQ Categories
nodes.norm_label: auth, token, timestamp & signature faq categories
nodes.rationale: Categorizes 12 app management/authorization FAQs (redirect URLs, error 105004, region restrictions) and 6 token/open_id/timestamp/signature FAQs (/api/v2/token/get, /api/token/refreshtoken error 36004001, invalid signature).

nodes.rationale: Categorizes 13 order/payment/fulfillment FAQs (AWAITING_SHIPMENT, PARTIALLY_SHIPPING, package_id), 30 product/catalog FAQs (GTIN/EAN/UPC/ISBN, warehouse_id, category rules), 14 logistics/package FAQs (split/combine, package freeze), and 2 reverse-order inventory FAQs.

nodes.label: Webhook, 429 Rate-Limit & Sandbox FAQ Categories
nodes.rationale: Categorizes 4 webhook/429 rate-limit/timeout FAQs, 23 sandbox/testing FAQs (test accounts, error 36009003, finance testing, MCN creator binding), and 9 miscellaneous OpenAPI FAQs.

nodes.label: TTSPC Support Ticket Escalation Checklist
nodes.rationale: Escalates unresolved issues to TTSPC / TikTok Shop Partner Center Contact Us with App Key, API name, full request and response payloads, error codes, timestamps, shop/region context, and screenshots.

nodes.label: OAS vs Partner Center Docv2 Source Priority
nodes.norm_label: oas vs partner center docv2 source priority
nodes.rationale: Prioritizes official OAS schemas and Partner Center docv2 over FAQ text or memory, reports gaps explicitly when schemas conflict or are missing, and directs unresolved questions to TTSPC Contact Us with request/response diagnostics.

nodes.label: Split OpenAPI 3.0.0 Reference Catalog (405 Paths)
nodes.rationale: Splits 405 OpenAPI 3.0.0 paths into 25 first-level domain files under references/oas/paths/ indexed by references/oas/index.json (including product 72, affiliate_seller 46, gs_full_service_commodity 36, analytics 35, gs_full_service_shipment 33, affiliate_creator 29, fulfillment 29, return_refund 14, order 9, finance 9, logistics 8).

nodes.label: Incremental Order Transition Verification Recipe
nodes.rationale: Creates one order, retries order list --page-size 10 for up to 30s until indexed, and runs one order transition per step while verifying visible state instead of hardcoding the full transition graph.

nodes.label: Sandbox Order Troubleshooting Matrix
nodes.rationale: Maps failure symptoms (sold-out SKU, partial batch failure, absent new order, transition timeout, unknown state, limit violations) to safe non-duplicating responses.

nodes.label: Canonical Sandbox Order State Machine
nodes.rationale: Enforces canonical state names (UNKNOWN, UNPAID, ON_HOLD, TO_SHIP, AWAITING_SHIPMENT, AWAITING_COLLECTION, CANCEL_PENDING, PARTIALLY_SHIPPING, SHIPPED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED) and forbids exposing backend numeric status codes.

nodes.label: Sandbox Material Evidence Record
nodes.rationale: Formats output as a compact YAML sandbox_order record with shop_id, product_id, sku_id, order_id, current_status, target_status, created_count, and request_ids while omitting tokens, cookies, and account nicknames.

nodes.label: TikTok US Custom App Integration Policy
nodes.norm_label: tiktok us custom app integration policy
nodes.rationale: Connects our own US TikTok Shop through US Partner Center (partner.us.tiktokshop.com) using a seller-developed custom app instead of an ISV app or UK/EU regions; prohibits TikTok for Business MCP because that is the Ads API (business-api.tiktok.com), not Shop API.

nodes.label: Partner Center Security & App Review Requirements
nodes.norm_label: partner center security & app review requirements
nodes.rationale: Applications must request minimal API scopes, keep app secrets out of frontend code, validate OAuth redirect URLs and callbacks, support token refresh and webhook retries, separate sandbox from production, and treat partner.tiktokshop.com/doc/home as the source of truth.

nodes.label: Toolkit Credential & Allowlist Safety Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Never prints or stores OAuth tokens, App Secrets, auth codes, PKCE verifiers, or Partner Center cookies; enforces backend allowlist via devapi call stripping secret fields; excludes /api/v2/sandbox/account/delete; rejects PPE headers in normal production use.

nodes.label: Six-Digit YYYYMM Version Selection Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Selects the numerically greatest six-digit YYYYMM operation implementing the exact requested capability and constraints without altering workflow sequence; retains older versions only for explicit pins or documented constraints and builds docv2 URLs as partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/{api}-{version}.

nodes.label: OpenAPI Version Selection & Anti-Stale Policy
nodes.rationale: Prevents choosing stale endpoint versions by treating bundled OAS as a baseline only, checking official Partner Center docv2 for newer candidates, picking the highest six-digit YYYYMM version meeting capability and constraints, and never guessing unverified fields.

nodes.label: Typed Sandbox Order Construction & Idempotent Recovery
nodes.norm_label: typed sandbox order construction & idempotent recovery
nodes.rationale: Restricts material creation to the 5 typed sandbox commands (no raw sandbox call, --version, or PPE headers); avoids duplicate test orders by polling order list up to 30s on indexing delay, retaining created order IDs on partial batch failures, and respecting stock_count and limits.
